name: MINT_NFT
description: Mint one or more NFTs in an existing collection. Each NFT gets its own metadata (base64-encoded, max 100 bytes each). Returns the serial numbers of the newly minted NFTs. The token must have a supply key.

implicitBehaviors.behavior: Metadata is base64-decoded before passing to SDK
implicitBehaviors.details: Each metadata string is decoded from base64 to Uint8Array using Buffer.from(raw, 'base64'). Accepts 'b64:' prefix which is stripped before decoding.

implicitBehaviors.behavior: Each metadata entry validated for size (1-100 bytes)
implicitBehaviors.details: Pre-flight checks ensure each decoded metadata is between 1 and 100 bytes. Returns METADATA_TOO_LARGE or METADATA_EMPTY errors.

implicitBehaviors.behavior: Supply key signing via freeze + sign pattern
implicitBehaviors.details: If supplyPrivateKey is provided, the transaction is frozen with freezeWith() then signed with the supply key. Otherwise operator key signs automatically.
After successful mint, receipt.serials contains Long values which are converted to numbers via Number(s.toString()).

inputs.name: metadata
inputs.describe: Array of base64-encoded metadata strings (1-10 per transaction, max 100 bytes each)

inputs.name: supplyPrivateKey
inputs.describe: Supply key for the token (only if different from operator key)

preflightChecks.check: Each metadata entry decodes to <= 100 bytes
preflightChecks.failDetails: Max 100 bytes per NFT metadata. Shorten it or use an IPFS CID hash instead.

preflightChecks.check: Each metadata entry decodes to > 0 bytes
preflightChecks.failDetails: Metadata decoded to 0 bytes. Provide valid base64-encoded content.

successData.name: serials
successData.describe: Serial numbers of the newly minted NFTs

errorMap.details: This collection has no supply key. NFT minting is permanently disabled.
Transaction signature is invalid. The supply key doesn't match.
The token ID does not exist on this network.
This collection has reached its maximum supply cap.
Network-level NFT minting limit reached for this price regime.
Not enough HBAR to cover the mint fee.
